# cream_jar — realism QA repair

Bulging glazed body; unglazed lower band; cork stopper. Dark cork flakes synthesized.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f2164, f2320, f2001. Mean silhouette IoU 0.8007. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/cream_jar_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/cream_jar/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=B, proportions=B, colour_texture=B, articulation=B, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Added profile-following thin wall collision bands and retained detachable cork stopper.
- Refined reference-view registration; changed unglazed foot colour and glass/ceramic properties.
- Generated cork flake texture from original colour and stopper appearance.

## Remaining

- The f2001 held-out view has significant registration/occlusion disagreement.
- Cork grain is synthesized, not measured; empty mass and contents unknown.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.
